Parfocal Clickable Mock

Parfocal is a viewer for AI results on whole slides. Researchers upload slides and AI results, assign review tasks and sign off the evaluation, and doctors check each AI object, fix it, comment and give their opinion. The slide is CAMELYON16 tumor_009, a sentinel lymph node with metastatic carcinoma. Overlays are drawn from the real tumor map and ground-truth outlines, and the nucleus outlines come from a quick threshold on the 40x field. Everything else is sample data. The personas, flows, wireframes, design system and test plan are in the UX Kit.
